entities.summary: Moldova is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Chișinău. Official languages include Romanian (Moldovan). Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 2.5 million. Area: 33,846 km². Comprehensive index for Moldova covering Dacian/Roman province (Dacia Traiana), medieval Principality of Moldavia (1346-1859, Ștefan cel Mare/Stephen the Great 1457-1504), Ottoman suzerainty, Russian Empire annexation (Bessarabia 1812), Romanian union (1918-40), Soviet Moldavian SSR (1940-91), independence 1991, Transnistria conflict (frozen since 1992), wine culture, EU candidacy 2022.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Moldova's history as a Dacian/Roman province and later Principality of Moldavia had significant regional impact during the medieval period. Its annexation by the Soviet Union led to its incorporation into the USSR, shaping the country's post-war trajectory.
